title: Live fleetd sessions stay reported as failed after a daemon restart until a new dispatch dials fleetd, and bro_resume on them refuses
wanted_capability: After a blackboxd restart, every harness session fleetd still holds is re-adopted into the task store at startup (task back to running, ingest replayed from its durable cursor), so bro_status, bro_wait, and bro_when_all see the live task without any new dispatch. bro_resume on a task whose supervision key is live attaches to (or points the caller at) the re-adopted task instead of failing with the multiplex refusal. Current code: re-adoption exists (FleetdExecutor::lane runs readopt_live_sessions after every successful dial, and readopt_harness_session flips the task back to running and strips the restart notice), but the dial is lazy: only spawn and inspect_workspace call lane(), so after a restart TaskStore::load marks running tasks failed with the 'server restarted while task was running' notice and they stay that way until some dispatch happens. A bro_resume of the same provider session collides with the live key in FleetdExecutor::spawn and bails with 'is genuinely live ... refusing to multiplex'. Re-adoption can also decline silently (owner-managed task, workspace-bound session without binding authority, mismatched binding), leaving a live worker the task plane cannot observe.
missing_primitive: startup re-adoption of live fleetd supervision keys into the daemon task store (or a bro_adopt verb), and a bro_resume path that attaches to a live session instead of refusing
fallback_used: Watched the lane branches and the on-disk event logs with a shell loop instead of the task plane.
evidence: src/orchestration/fleetd_client.rs: FleetdExecutor::lane (re-adoption only after a dial), spawn (supervision-key collision bail), readopt_live_sessions, readopt_one
src/orchestration/mod.rs: readopt_harness_session (decline paths return None with a warn log), RESTART_NOTICE_PREFIX / strip_restart_notice, install_harness_executor_with_config (no startup dial)
src/orchestration/mod.rs: harness_executor().inspect_workspace and harness_executor().spawn are the only dial triggers, both in the dispatch path
src/orchestration/fleetd_smoke.rs: a_replacement_daemon_reattaches_the_task_and_replays_what_it_missed forces the connect by dispatching
Observed: two fleetd-supervised dispatches survived daemon restarts and kept committing while their tasks read failed and bro_resume refused on the live supervision key
